questlog:campaign/opening/a_new_master.objective_clarification: Sire, claim the Tower's first obedience. Everything useful follows from possession.
questlog:campaign/opening/a_new_master.first_reminder: Sire, the Tower is waiting. Sentiment is no substitute for possession.
repeat_reminders: Master, a throne unclaimed is merely expensive furniture.
Sire, do begin ruling before the world mistakes silence for mercy.
questlog:campaign/opening/a_new_master.success: Excellent, Sire. The Tower recognizes its master. Now we may become unreasonable.
questlog:campaign/opening/a_new_master.post_quest: The first claim is made. Next we require Minions, facilities, and better victims.

questlog:campaign/opening/restore_browns.objective_clarification: Sire, the Browns are your first working hands. Recover their command before demanding elegance.
questlog:campaign/opening/restore_browns.first_reminder: Master, an Overlord without Minions is merely a well-dressed pedestrian.
repeat_reminders: Sire, recover the Browns. The Tower will not restore itself out of respect.
questlog:campaign/opening/restore_browns.success: Good. Brown command is restored. At last, something else can carry the heavy objects.
questlog:campaign/opening/restore_browns.post_quest: The first Minions are back in service. We can now make restoration properly unfair.

questlog:campaign/tower/claim_the_throne.objective_clarification: Sire, formalize the seat of rule. A Tower needs a master it can answer to.
questlog:campaign/tower/claim_the_throne.first_reminder: Master, the throne is not decorative. Claim it before someone develops ideas.
repeat_reminders: Sire, sovereignty improves considerably once it has a seat.
questlog:campaign/tower/claim_the_throne.success: The throne is operational, Sire. Bureaucracy may now fear the correct person.
questlog:campaign/tower/claim_the_throne.post_quest: The seat of power is restored. The remaining rooms may be treated as assets.

questlog:campaign/tower/prepare_the_forg.delivery_direction: Facility need, proof of operation, utility.
questlog:campaign/tower/prepare_the_forg.objective_clarification: Sire, restore a working forge. Conquest consumes metal with admirable enthusiasm.
questlog:campaign/tower/prepare_the_forg.first_reminder: Master, weapons do not improve through optimism. Prepare the forge.
repeat_reminders: Sire, a cold forge is an insult to every future campaign.
questlog:campaign/tower/prepare_the_forg.success: The forge is prepared. We may now replace improvisation with properly sharpened malice.
questlog:campaign/tower/prepare_the_forg.post_quest: Forge capacity is restored. Equipment can now support the reign instead of delaying it.

questlog:campaign/tower/magic/prepare_bi.delivery_direction: Clarify the limited facility scope and avoid mastery creep.
questlog:campaign/tower/magic/prepare_bi.objective_clarification: Sire, Gnarl's flesh-work needs a room, not mastery. Establish the Bio-Forge and move on.
questlog:campaign/tower/magic/prepare_bi.first_reminder: The Biomancy chamber need only become operational. Perfection can wait for fresh specimens.
repeat_reminders: Master, one working Bio-Forge is sufficient for the Tower. The uglier refinements come later.
questlog:campaign/tower/magic/prepare_bi.success: Good. The flesh laboratory lives. Deeper abominations may proceed on their own schedule.
questlog:campaign/tower/magic/prepare_bi.post_quest: Biomancy now has a place in the Tower without becoming a condition of restoration.

questlog:campaign/tower/restoration_comp.delivery_direction: Acknowledge core readiness without implying optional completionism.
questlog:campaign/tower/restoration_comp.objective_clarification: Sire, finish the seven core facilities. Optional studies may remain gloriously unfinished.
questlog:campaign/tower/restoration_comp.first_reminder: Master, restore the Tower's essentials. We are building a seat of power, not a museum catalogue.
repeat_reminders: Sire, the core rooms decide readiness. Exotic laboratories may continue wasting time afterward.
questlog:campaign/tower/restoration_comp.success: The Dark Tower is operational, Sire. It need not be finished to be feared.
questlog:campaign/tower/restoration_comp.post_quest: The foundation of the reign is secure. Expansion can now become everyone else's problem.

questlog:campaign/expansion/the_reign_ta.objective_clarification: Sire, consolidate the first foundation. After that, the world becomes a list of acquisitions.
questlog:campaign/expansion/the_reign_ta.first_reminder: Master, finish the foundation before multiplying fronts. Even evil benefits from accounting.
repeat_reminders: Sire, a reign expands more efficiently once its first obligations are actually complete.
questlog:campaign/expansion/the_reign_ta.success: Excellent. The reign has a foundation. We may now acquire specialists, peoples, and grudges.
questlog:campaign/expansion/the_reign_ta.post_quest: The early structure is stable. Expansion and specialized disciplines are now legitimate priorities.

questlog:campaign/magic/irons/open_the_s.delivery_direction: Identify the discipline, then direct practical study.
questlog:campaign/magic/irons/open_the_s.objective_clarification: Sire, active spellcraft rewards practice, not reverence. Open the discipline and learn what obeys.
questlog:campaign/magic/irons/open_the_s.first_reminder: Master, mana is available. Ignorance is therefore a voluntary limitation.
repeat_reminders: Sire, study the spellbook before someone less deserving becomes competent.
questlog:campaign/magic/irons/open_the_s.success: Good. Formal spellcraft is open to you. The schools may now compete for usefulness.

questlog:campaign/magic/gluttony/feed_th.delivery_direction: Explain magical cuisine without degrading mundane cooking.
questlog:campaign/magic/gluttony/feed_th.objective_clarification: Sire, Gluttony begins where cooking stops being merely edible and starts consuming mana.
questlog:campaign/magic/gluttony/feed_th.first_reminder: Master, the meal is supposed to be magical. Ordinary dinner remains distressingly common.
repeat_reminders: Sire, feed the spell properly. Appetite alone is not yet a school of magic.
questlog:campaign/magic/gluttony/feed_th.success: There. Cuisine has crossed into spellcraft. The kitchen may now commit more interesting offenses.

questlog:campaign/magic/theurgy/first_ro.delivery_direction: Define matter-work and give the next practical step.
questlog:campaign/magic/theurgy/first_ro.objective_clarification: Sire, Theurgy studies the hidden laws of matter. Begin by making those laws answer questions.
questlog:campaign/magic/theurgy/first_ro.first_reminder: Master, minerals are remarkably cooperative once one stops asking politely.
repeat_reminders: Sire, prepare the rod. Material truth is useful when ownership is negotiable.
questlog:campaign/magic/theurgy/first_ro.success: Good. Matter has begun surrendering information before we force it to surrender form.

questlog:campaign/magic/alchemy/beyond_t.delivery_direction: Define pharmacology, then move toward controlled effects.
questlog:campaign/magic/alchemy/beyond_t.objective_clarification: Sire, Ars Elixirum is controlled effect composition. Move beyond crude potions and make the dose deliberate.
questlog:campaign/magic/alchemy/beyond_t.first_reminder: Master, a bottle is not mastery. Refine the effect until the result is intentional.
repeat_reminders: Sire, continue the alchemical work. Accidental medicine is for peasants.
questlog:campaign/magic/alchemy/beyond_t.success: Excellent. The mixture is becoming a discipline rather than a cupboard of suspicious liquids.

questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/a_lesso.delivery_direction: State Gnarl's recent discovery, then require first proof.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/a_lesso.objective_clarification: Sire, during the Silence I learned that enough magic makes flesh reconsider its limitations. Begin there.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/a_lesso.first_reminder: Master, flesh is waiting to be improved. It has had quite long enough in its natural condition.
repeat_reminders: Sire, secure the Primordial Core and Living Flesh milestones. The theory deserves specimens.

objective_updates.1: One principle is proven. Complete the second before declaring the flesh obedient.

questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/a_lesso.success: Good. You have the premise. Flesh can be made to function as more than anatomy.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/a_lesso.post_quest: The foundation is understood. Processing apparatus is the next sensible indignity.

questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/flesh_a.delivery_direction: Track apparatus growth and keep each machine purposeful.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/flesh_a.objective_clarification: Sire, build the processing chain. Forge, decompose, digest, and make flesh perform useful work.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/flesh_a.first_reminder: Master, biological engineering requires machinery, even when the machinery is disturbingly alive.
repeat_reminders: Sire, continue the apparatus. A half-built organism is merely waste with ambition.

objective_updates.1: The first apparatus is working. Add the next process before admiring it.
objective_updates.2: Two processes are established. Complete the chain and make the laboratory useful.

questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/flesh_a.success: Splendid. Flesh now behaves like an engineered system instead of an excuse for anatomy.

questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/the_liv.delivery_direction: Track advanced laboratory milestones without folding them into Tower restoration.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/the_liv.objective_clarification: Sire, this is mastery work now. Bio-Lab, Injector, and Cradle belong to Biomancy itself.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/the_liv.first_reminder: Master, the Tower room is already sufficient. These devices are for making the discipline dangerous.
repeat_reminders: Sire, continue the living laboratory. Gnarl's old experiments deserve competent supervision.

objective_updates.1: The Bio-Lab is established. Controlled flesh-work can finally become systematic.
objective_updates.2: The Injector is ready. One final apparatus remains before the laboratory is complete.

questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/the_liv.warning: Sire, advanced Biomancy is not ordinary crafting. Treat unstable flesh as a problem before it becomes personnel.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/the_liv.success: Splendid. Biomancy is now a discipline rather than one of Gnarl's unfortunate hobbies.
questlog:campaign/magic/biomancy/the_liv.post_quest: The living laboratory is complete. Further monstrosity may now proceed intentionally.

questlog:campaign/magic/eidolon/raise_th.delivery_direction: Frame ritual occultism as deliberate preparation.
questlog:campaign/magic/eidolon/raise_th.objective_clarification: Sire, Eidolon rewards preparation. Raise the altar before expecting souls and rites to behave.
questlog:campaign/magic/eidolon/raise_th.first_reminder: Master, rituals without apparatus are merely dramatic mistakes.
repeat_reminders: Sire, prepare the occult workspace. The dead are rarely punctual on their own.
questlog:campaign/magic/eidolon/raise_th.success: Good. The ritual foundation is ready. We may now make death more administratively useful.

questlog:campaign/adventures/twilight/ol.delivery_direction: Treat the realm as a conquest problem, not inherited lore.
questlog:campaign/adventures/twilight/ol.objective_clarification: Sire, the Twilight Forest has its own barriers and rulers. Learn the order before breaking it.
questlog:campaign/adventures/twilight/ol.first_reminder: Master, the forest will not simplify itself. Establish the first route through its protections.
repeat_reminders: Sire, proceed through the forest's order. Then we can decide which parts deserve to remain.
questlog:campaign/adventures/twilight/ol.success: Good. The old forest has noticed a new master. Continue before it develops confidence.

questlog:campaign/adventures/bumblezone/.delivery_direction: Identify the exceptional realm and make exploration actionable.
questlog:campaign/adventures/bumblezone/.objective_clarification: Sire, the hive realm is absurdly full of bees and therefore, regrettably, resources. Enter it deliberately.
questlog:campaign/adventures/bumblezone/.first_reminder: Master, the bees remain unconquered by your reluctance to visit them.
repeat_reminders: Sire, enter the hive. Try not to be defeated by organized pollination.
questlog:campaign/adventures/bumblezone/.success: Excellent. The hive is accessible. We may now discover what the insects were hiding.

questlog:campaign/adventures/cataclysm/r.delivery_direction: Warn about high-threat ruins and demand reconnaissance.
questlog:campaign/adventures/cataclysm/r.objective_clarification: Sire, these ruins contain threats built for heroes to fear. That makes them worth inspecting.
questlog:campaign/adventures/cataclysm/r.first_reminder: Master, identify the awakened ruin before charging into whichever horror owns it.
repeat_reminders: Sire, the ruin is still there. Its inhabitants have not improved with patience.
questlog:campaign/adventures/cataclysm/r.warning: Sire, Cataclysm sites punish careless entry. Retreating to return stronger is management, not mercy.
questlog:campaign/adventures/cataclysm/r.success: Good. We know where the danger lives. The next step is making that information fatal to it.
questlog:campaign/adventures/cataclysm/r.failure: Withdraw, Sire. A temporary retreat is preferable to leaving the Tower to less competent management.

questlog:campaign/adventures/graveyard/p.delivery_direction: Separate hostile undead sites from diplomatic civilization logic.
questlog:campaign/adventures/graveyard/p.objective_clarification: Sire, the dead keep places of their own. Find the site; do not mistake occupation for diplomacy.
questlog:campaign/adventures/graveyard/p.first_reminder: Master, locate the graveyard. Corpses are easier to manage when one knows where they gather.
repeat_reminders: Sire, the dead remain where they are least useful. Correct the information deficit.
questlog:campaign/adventures/graveyard/p.warning: Undead are not a civilization waiting for terms, Sire. Treat whatever answers as a magical or military problem.
questlog:campaign/adventures/graveyard/p.success: The site is known. We may now decide which dead deserve a second death and which deserve employment.

questlog:campaign/adventures/knight/esse.delivery_direction: Treat the relic trail as useful evidence rather than imported mythology.
questlog:campaign/adventures/knight/esse.objective_clarification: Sire, follow the essence trail. Old power is usually most valuable before someone explains its proper use.
questlog:campaign/adventures/knight/esse.first_reminder: Master, the relic will not volunteer itself. Continue the search.
repeat_reminders: Sire, pursue the essence. Antiquity is not a defense against confiscation.
questlog:campaign/adventures/knight/esse.success: Good. The trail is real. Let us see what sort of power believed dust was adequate security.

questlog:campaign/adventures/lost_castle.objective_clarification: Sire, a castle missing from ordinary maps is either valuable or badly managed. Find out which.
questlog:campaign/adventures/lost_castle.first_reminder: Master, locate the castle. Hidden fortifications become much less mysterious once invaded.
repeat_reminders: Sire, continue the search. Someone is enjoying privacy they have not earned.
questlog:campaign/adventures/lost_castle.success: There it is. The castle is no longer lost, which is unfortunate for whoever occupies it.

questlog:campaign/adventures/rats/empire.delivery_direction: Acknowledge the ridiculous premise, then treat the threat seriously.
questlog:campaign/adventures/rats/empire.objective_clarification: Sire, there appears to be an empire of rats. Laugh after we know what they own.
questlog:campaign/adventures/rats/empire.first_reminder: Master, investigate the rat empire. Ridicule is more satisfying with accurate intelligence.
repeat_reminders: Sire, the rodents remain organized. This is becoming embarrassing for larger species.
questlog:campaign/adventures/rats/empire.success: Good. Their little empire is confirmed. Now we can decide how much of it is worth stealing.

questlog:campaign/adventures/church_of_s.delivery_direction: Identify the site without importing its theology as canon.
questlog:campaign/adventures/church_of_s.objective_clarification: Sire, find the cursed cathedral. Its symbols matter less than whatever power still answers inside.
questlog:campaign/adventures/church_of_s.first_reminder: Master, locate the cathedral before its congregation acquires more initiative.
repeat_reminders: Sire, cursed architecture is still architecture. Find the place and assess its occupants.
questlog:campaign/adventures/church_of_s.success: The cathedral is located. We can now separate useful occultism from useless devotion.

questlog:campaign/adventures/oddities/fi.delivery_direction: Treat the shrine as an anomalous resource site.
questlog:campaign/adventures/oddities/fi.objective_clarification: Sire, locate the orchid shrine. Anything that attracts this much strangeness deserves inspection.
questlog:campaign/adventures/oddities/fi.first_reminder: Master, find the shrine. Unclaimed oddities have an irritating habit of becoming someone else's advantage.
repeat_reminders: Sire, continue the search. Strange plants are still resources if handled aggressively enough.
questlog:campaign/adventures/oddities/fi.success: Good. The shrine is found. We may now determine whether the oddity is useful, hostile, or both.

questlog:campaign/end/the_wound_beyond_t.delivery_direction: Connect Ender phenomena to the dimensional Wasteland without overexplaining cosmology.
questlog:campaign/end/the_wound_beyond_t.objective_clarification: Sire, the End is tied to the old dimensional wound. Enter it as a catastrophe's consequence, not ordinary travel.
questlog:campaign/end/the_wound_beyond_t.first_reminder: Master, the wound beyond the world remains open. Reach it when the expedition is prepared.
repeat_reminders: Sire, the End will wait. Unfortunately, so will everything living there.
questlog:campaign/end/the_wound_beyond_t.warning: Sire, that realm is not ordinary distance. The Cataclysm left reality badly stitched.
questlog:campaign/end/the_wound_beyond_t.success: You have crossed the wound. Now discover what survived on the other side.
questlog:campaign/end/the_wound_beyond_t.post_quest: The dimensional Wasteland is accessible. Ender power is no longer an abstraction.

questlog:campaign/end/break_the_dragon.delivery_direction: Treat the dragon as the immediate military obstacle, not cosmological ownership.
questlog:campaign/end/break_the_dragon.objective_clarification: Sire, the dragon controls the obvious battlefield. Break it before drawing larger conclusions about the realm.
questlog:campaign/end/break_the_dragon.first_reminder: Master, the dragon remains alive. This is a correctable administrative defect.
repeat_reminders: Sire, kill the dragon. Dimensional study improves once the largest interruption stops breathing.
questlog:campaign/end/break_the_dragon.warning: Do not confuse victory over one creature with understanding the Wasteland, Sire.
questlog:campaign/end/break_the_dragon.success: Excellent. The dragon is dead. The realm remains, which makes it the more interesting problem.
questlog:campaign/end/break_the_dragon.post_quest: The immediate obstacle is removed. The End can now be explored without pretending its history is solved.
